notes.title: We're Back and Continuing Development!
notes.content:
Thank you so much to everyone who has played our game -- you mean the world to us, and we wouldn't be here without you.

If you enjoyed [i]Bed and BEAKfast[/i], we have some exciting news!! The team is [b]continuing production[/b] (!!!!!!), this time with a new name: [i]Sincerely, Robin[/i].

If you want to be updated on our progress, we're on social media! Our website is [url=https://fiftybirds.com/]fiftybirds.com[/url], and there you can find our socials: [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@fifty_birds]TikTok[/url], [url=https://x.com/fifty_birds]Twitter/X[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/fifty_birds/#]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@Fifty_Birds]YouTube[/url], and [url=https://bsky.app/profile/fiftybirds.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url].

If you're looking for a way to support the game, we'd love if you reviewed us on Steam and/or posted about us on socials! It helps us get the word out there so more people can enjoy :)

Sincerely,
The Fifty Birds Team <3
